protected_rules: Detection never assigns a semantic classification.
Newer publication or verification date never implies supersession.
CHALLENGE and FALSIFY never mutate or delete active evidence automatically.
REMOVED sources cannot be classified as SUPPORT or EXTEND.
A removed source supporting live evidence may resolve only through SCOPE, CHALLENGE or FALSIFY.
Removed-source resolutions are constrained by classification and cannot close as a no-op challenge.
FALSIFY resolved as superseded requires distinct replacement evidence that exists and is live in the candidate ledger.
FALSIFY supersession must move at least one previously live affected evidence record out of live status.
READY requires review of every affected live evidence claim.
R3 requires at least one substantive downstream action.
Unknown authority or strength transitions fail closed as R3.
Registry-level metadata changes fail closed through SOURCE-REGISTRY.
